ideas.pitch: A gamified incident response platform that feeds live security alerts and digital clues to teams under strict countdown timers.
ideas.problem_statement: Cybersecurity-themed challenges, digital clues, system vulnerabilities, and time-sensitive problems under pressure.
ideas.title: BreachTime: Real-Time Incident Triage & Digital Clue Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly matches the high-energy, time-sensitive simulation format of Kill Switch, testing judges' criteria of decision-making under pressure.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered security agent that monitors LLM tool calls and logs for prompt injections and unauthorized data exfiltration attempts in real time.
ideas.problem_statement: System vulnerabilities, security scenarios, and identifying potential risks when every second counts.
ideas.title: AgenticArmor: Defensive Prompt-Injection & Log Scraper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced defense-in-depth patterns from successful hackathon agent projects to tackle modern software attack vectors.

ideas.pitch: A rapid code analysis tool that scans repositories for security misconfigurations and generates immediate executive risk reports.
ideas.problem_statement: Analyze available information, identify potential risks, and determine the correct course of action.
ideas.title: VulnerabilityPulse: Automated Repository Security Insights
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning formula of automated repository auditing and reporting tools that secure high placements at technical hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A localized NLP tool that rapidly analyzes suspicious call transcripts, SMS logs, and email payloads to detect phishing attempts instantly.
ideas.problem_statement: Technical challenges involving security scenarios, digital clues, and system vulnerabilities.
ideas.title: PhishGuard: BERT-Powered Multi-Channel Threat Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts proven award-winning ML spam detection architectures into an agile, real-time security triage assistant.

ideas.pitch: A fast forensic workspace that ingests raw server logs, correlates anomalies, and visualizes attack paths for quick root-cause deduction.
ideas.problem_statement: Logical reasoning and analysis of digital clues to solve time-bound security tasks.
ideas.title: SecOps LogDecoder: Digital Forensics & Log Puzzle Solver
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the competition's emphasis on logical reasoning and handling time-bound digital clue analysis.
